title: Runepowder Bomb
summary: Destroy to trigger a 60-ft Force blast and knockback.

fields.Activation: Action to Throw. Detonates when destroyed at 0 of its 4 HP. A throw that does not destroy it can leave it inert. A nearby blast that destroys it can trigger another detonation.
fields.Blast: 60 ft actual radius, larger than the aiming preview. Deals 10d8 + 40 Force. DC 12 Dexterity save halves damage. Creatures are knocked back 20 ft without a save.
fields.Objects: The tooltip describes a critical hit against objects and terrain. The source instead reports an extra 23 Force without doubling the damage dice.
fields.Throw: The 35 lb object needs at least Strength 9 to throw. Distance depends on Strength and weight, up to 60 ft. It can survive landing or Fire damage if its HP remains. Globe of Invulnerability blocks blast damage.
fields.Acquisition: Wulbren gives it for Avenge the Ironhands, or find it on his desk in Angleiron’s Cellar. No purchase or Alchemy recipe.
fields.Foundry: Using it at the Steel Watch Foundry Neurocitor breaks the Oath of Devotion. Foundry destruction can trigger A Dish Served Cold, A Massacre Beyond Imagining, Catastrophic Structural Failure, Love That Smell, or The Art of Destruction. Witnessing the blast anywhere can trigger A Foul and Awesome Display.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
